title: Propositional logic and truth tables
covers: Connectives (¬ ∧ ∨ → ↔ ⊕), translating English into formulas, precedence, truth tables, evaluating formulas, tautologies and contradictions.

title: Equivalence, Boolean algebra and simplification
covers: Logical equivalence, the laws of Boolean algebra (De Morgan, distribution, absorption), contrapositive/converse/inverse, simplifying formulas, normal forms and logic circuits.

title: Predicates and quantifiers
covers: Predicates, ∀ and ∃, negating quantified statements, nested quantifiers and their order, evaluating statements over small finite domains.

title: Deduction, valid and invalid arguments, proof patterns
covers: Validity, modus ponens/tollens, syllogisms, recognising fallacies, chains of implications, proof by contradiction, contrapositive and cases.

title: Logic puzzles and dense logical statements
covers: Knights and knaves, constraint/arrangement puzzles, 'only if', 'unless', necessary vs sufficient, reading long conditional statements precisely.

title: Patterns, sequences and rules
covers: Number and letter sequences, rule discovery, recurrences, rewriting systems and grid/figure patterns.

title: Tracing algorithms and pseudocode
covers: Trace tables, loops, conditionals, arrays, nested loops, functions, stacks and queues in pseudocode.

title: Graphs, paths and trees
covers: Degrees, shortest paths (BFS/Dijkstra), spanning trees, counting paths, trees, Euler paths, colouring and dependency orders — Bebras style.

title: Sorting, searching, recursion and complexity
covers: Linear/binary search, bubble/selection/insertion/merge sort behaviour, recursion and call counts, growth rates and step counting.

title: Counting, combinatorics and optimisation puzzles
covers: Multiplication principle, permutations/combinations, inclusion–exclusion, pigeonhole, and small optimisation puzzles (scheduling, packing, greedy vs optimal).

title: State machines, encodings and binary
covers: Finite-state machines, binary/hex, bitwise operations, parity and checksums, simple ciphers and run-length/encoding schemes.

title: Algebra and functions review
covers: Rewriting expressions, equations and inequalities (incl. absolute value and roots), systems of linear equations, compositions and inverses, domain/range, transformations.

title: Limits and continuity
covers: Limits of standard functions, one-sided limits, limits at infinity, asymptotes, continuity and removable discontinuities.

title: Derivatives (rules, chain, implicit)
covers: Derivatives of standard functions, product/quotient/chain rules, implicit differentiation, second derivatives, tangent and normal lines.

title: Applications of derivatives
covers: Increasing/decreasing, extrema, inflection points, curve sketching, optimisation, related rates, distance–velocity–acceleration.

title: Integrals (definite, FTC, u-substitution)
covers: Antiderivatives of standard functions, definite integrals, FTC, integrals of the form c·f(ax+b)+d, u-substitution, area, mean value and volume of revolution.

title: Exponentials, logarithms and trigonometry
covers: Exponent and log rules, exponential/log equations, exact trig values, unit circle, identities on the formula sheet, solving trig equations and inequalities, sinusoids.

title: Geometry and vectors
covers: Areas and volumes, triangle properties, sine and cosine rules, lines and circles, intersections, vectors, dot product, orthogonality, motion along a vector path.
